RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Not reliably estimable from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias—just as an all-men panel would not be. Your qualifications make your disappointment understandable, but a leadership appointment may weigh management, regulatory expertise, and interview performance alongside technical credentials. The announcement cannot establish who was better qualified.

Follow up in writing, requesting the selection criteria, feedback on your assessment, and the expected response date. Two weeks’ silence warrants chasing, but does not establish discrimination.

Raise sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-based comments or inconsistent application of criteria. If you might challenge the decision, check local deadlines promptly; waiting for feedback may not pause them.
